verses.1: And Shephatiah son of Mattan, and Gedaliah son of Pashhur, and Jokar son of Shalmeiah, and Pashhur son of Malchiah heard what Jeremiah said to all the people.
verses.2: Thus said Jehovah, who sits in this city: “He will die in the time of famine and starvation. He will die from eating rotten food. But he will also live again. His soul will be saved from death.”
verses.3: So said Jehovah: “You shall give this city into the hands of King Babylon’s army.”
verses.4: And the prophets said to the king, “Please kill this man, for he is able to heal the hands of those soldiers who remain in this city. He can also make everyone in this city speak these words. This man does not seek to do good for this people; instead, he only seeks their harm.”
verses.5: And King Zedekiah said, “Look, they have him in their hands. It seems that the king cannot do anything to them.”
verses.6: They took Jeremiah and threw him into the pit. He was thrown into the pit by King Malkia, who lived in the palace of the king. There was no water in the pit; only mud. Jeremiah drowned in that mud.
verses.7: And the servant of the king of Kush heard that Saris had arrived at the king’s palace. It was said that Jirmiyah had been given to him, and the king sat in his throne room in Benyamin.
verses.8: And the servant of the king went out from the king’s house and spoke to the king, saying:
verses.9: King Adonai’s enemies caused these people to do everything they could to harm Jeremiah, the prophet. They threw him into the river, and he died from starvation, because there was no food left in the city at all.
verses.10: The king ordered the servant of the king of Kush to say, “Take with you thirty men, and bring up Jeremiah from the prison before he dies.”
verses.11: And the king’s servant took those people with his hands. He entered the king’s house, down to the bottom of the storage room. There, he took some clothes and salt from there. Then he sent them to Jarmiyah, into the prison.
verses.12: And the servant of the king of Kush said to Jeremias, “Please place your hands under the loins of the soldiers and sailors.” And Jeremias did as he was told.
verses.13: They put Jeremiah in the cages, and they brought him up from the dungeon. Then Jeremiah sat down in the courtyard of the prison.
verses.14: And the king sent Zadkiah, and he took Jeremiah to the third priest in the house of God. The king said to Jeremiah, “I ask you, do not speak anything that could be repeated by others.”
verses.15: And Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, “I will tell you that I will not die. And I will warn you that you will not listen to me.”
verses.16: And King Zedekiah went to Jeremiah and said, “May the LORD live! He has done this for us. Do you really believe this? Or do you accept that you will be handed over to these people who are demanding your life?”
verses.17: And Jirmiyah said to Tzidkiyah, “As the Lord, the God of armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you go and speak to the kings of Babylon, then your soul will be saved. And this city will not be destroyed by fire. You and your house will live.’”
verses.18: And if you do not go to the soldiers of King Babylon, and if this city is given into the hands of the enemies, and it is burned with fire, then you will not be able to escape from the ashes.
verses.19: And King Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, “I am worried about the Jews who have fallen into the hands of their enemies. They will hand me over to them and mistreat me.”
verses.20: And Jeremiah said, “Do not listen to Shma’nah. For it is the voice of the LORD that I speak to you. It will be good for you, and your soul will live.”
verses.21: And if you refuse to go, then this is what Jehovah has commanded.
verses.22: And behold, all the women who remained in the house of the king of Judah came forth. They went before the princes of Babylon. They said, “You have been defeated by your own people. Your feet were trampled by the floodwaters.”
verses.23: And all your women and children will be brought before the lions. You yourself will not be able to escape from them, for you will be captured by King Babylon. And that city will be destroyed by fire.
verses.24: And Zadkiah said to Jeremias, “One who does not understand these words shall not live.”
verses.25: And when the messengers heard what I said to you, they came to you and said, “Please tell us what you said to the king. Do not be harsh with us, and do not kill us.” And what did the king say to you?
verses.26: And you said to them, “I will stay here before the king. I will not be taken back to the house of Jehovanath, where I will die.”
verses.27: And all the prophets came to Jeremiah and asked him questions. They told him all these things that the king had commanded them to say. But they were not convinced by his words, because they hadn’t heard them before.
verses.28: And Jeremiah stayed in the Temple’s courtyard until the day when Jerusalem was captured. And it happened as if Jerusalem had indeed been captured at that time.
